excluded.reason: conceptual data-exchange diagram; no runtime evaluation

evaluations.title: FFT correctness, API arguments and memory guards
evaluations.coverage: FP16/TF32 forward/inverse, seven sizes, public/core and guards; no performance claim

evaluations.title: Theoretical model and measured cuFFTDx utilization
evaluations.coverage: Calculated A100 model rows and measured cuFFTDx row from independently collected Table 3 parts; portable offline assembly

evaluations.title: FFT kernel performance across GPUs, precisions and placements
evaluations.coverage: Independent ThunderFFT/cuFFTDx library and configuration parts; 168 configuration cells across A100/H100/B200 with raw evidence validation, candidate selection and speedups

evaluations.title: Peak, ideal MMA and 64-point unit throughput
evaluations.coverage: Measured TF32 m16n8k8 ideal throughput, N64 unit throughput reused from Table 3, and efficiency on matching GPU UUIDs; one GPU per run with offline multi-GPU assembly; hardware peaks are paper references

evaluations.title: Numerical accuracy and finite dynamic range
evaluations.coverage: Accuracy and finite-range measurements; FP16/TF32 ThunderFFT, optional cuFFTDx FP32 and FP16 (MathDX); seed and input details not stated in the paper

evaluations.title: Comparison with prior Tensor Core FFT libraries
evaluations.coverage: A100 N256 FP16 batch65536 four-library comparison; selected-library builds and independent collection, raw CSV/log revalidation and offline speedup assembly

evaluations.title: 64-point optimization ablation
evaluations.coverage: N64 TF32 unit-kernel timings: 51e346c branch and 5e37821 uniform complete-FFT candidates, plus optional e4aa1b0 and 652808b partial kernels in timing-only mode; radix16 baseline estimated from validated Table 6 tcFFT while retaining utilization (0.375 times N256 FP16 time at batch65536); radix4_compute source remains missing, and full paper-stage identity is unconfirmed

evaluations.title: A100 register-resident FFT kernel timing
evaluations.coverage: Four A100 register series derived from assembled Table 3, including selected cuFFTDx candidates; missing sizes remain blank

evaluations.title: FFT performance normalized by communication-only baseline
evaluations.coverage: Independent communication-only, ThunderFFT, cuFFT and cuFFTDx parts; offline normalization and GPU/precision plots

evaluations.title: A100 1D convolution comparison
evaluations.coverage: Native ThunderFFT, cuDNN and pinned FlashFFTConv L4096 convolution with validation, per-library/filter collection and offline assembly; precision details recorded

evaluations.title: A100 2D convolution comparison
evaluations.coverage: Native cuDNN, full-image cuFFT, tiled64 cuFFTDx C2C and tiled64 TF32 ThunderFFT C2C (real FP32 input/output) with validation and offline assembly
